name: new_line_signalling_tests_with_service_impact
description: Synthetic Category contract case (RC-68): signalling tests and switch works for a line not yet open, which affected the evening service of a connecting running line.

candidates.title: Future tram line tests signalling at night at its junction with a running line
candidates.search_snippet: Night signalling tests and new switch works took place at the junction of the future tram line.
candidates.source_content: Night tests of the signalling system and new switch works took place at the station where the future tram line will connect to an existing line. The teams checked the switch movements, position detection and the data sent to the control system. Service on the existing line was affected from 21:30 on the three nights of the works.
